name: Daniela Reyes
text:
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you (except an attack of opportunity you provoked), even if that attack was canceled: Either deal 1 damage to that enemy, or automatically evade it.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you were attacked by an enemy this round, you automatically succeed, instead.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mechanic's Wrench, Mob Goons, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "Relax, tough guy. I'll handle this. You stand over there and look pretty."

name: Mechanic's Wrench
text: Daniela Reyes deck only. [fast] Exhaust Mechanic's Wrench: Choose an enemy at your location. That enemy attacks you. [action]: Fight. Use this ability only against an enemy that has attacked you since the end of your last turn. You get +2 [combat] for this attack and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Mob Goons
text: Hunter. Prey - Daniela Reyes only. This enemy's attacks cannot be canceled. Damage/horror dealt by this enemy's attacks is treated as direct.
flavor: Debt is a family affair.

name: Norman Withers
text: Play with the top card of your deck revealed. Once per round, you may play the top card of your deck as if it were in your hand, at -1 resource cost. Forced - After a weakness is revealed while on top of your deck: Draw it. [elder_sign] effect: +X. You may swap the top card of your deck with a card in your hand. X is the resource cost of the top card of your deck.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Livre d'Eibon, The Harbinger, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Livre d'Eibon
text:
Norman Withers deck only.
[fast] Exhaust Livre d'Eibon: Swap the top card of your deck with a card in your hand.
[fast] Exhaust Livre d'Eibon: Commit the top card of your deck to an eligible skill test performed by an investigator at your location.

name: The Harbinger
text: Revelation - Place this card on top of your deck. While The Harbinger is revealed and on top of your deck, cards in your deck cannot be searched, drawn, or manipulated in any way except by the below ability. [action][action]: Discard The Harbinger. This ability may be activated while The Harbinger is on top of your deck, as if it were in your threat area.

name: Monterey Jack
text:
[reaction] At the end of your turn, if you started this round 1 location away from your current location: Either gain 1 resource or draw 1 card (if you started this round 2 or more locations away, do both instead).
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you started this round 1 or more locations away from your current location, gain 1 resource or draw 1 card.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Trusty Bullwhip, Buried Secrets, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Trusty Bullwhip
text: Fast. Monterey Jack deck only. [action]: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. If this attack succeeds, you may exhaust Trusty Bullwhip to either automatically evade the attacked enemy or deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Buried Secrets
text: Revelation - Put Buried Secrets into play in your threat area. If your location can be investigated, you cannot move except by scenario card effects. [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Buried Secrets. If you fail, you may take 2 horror to shuffle it into your deck.

name: Lily Chen
text:
You begin the game with each Discipline in your deck in play, [[Unbroken]] side faceup.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. After this test ends, flip a [[Broken]] Discipline you control to its [[Unbroken]] side.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 1 Burden of Destiny for each Discipline asset (see below), 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Firearm]] assets. Additional Requirements: At deck creation, choose a Discipline asset to add to your deck. It is considered part of your Deckbuilding Requirements. For every 15 experience you've earned in total, you may choose and add a different Discipline asset to your deck.
flavor: "I have been preparing to confront this evil my entire life. My focus must be absolute."

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
You get +1 [willpower].
[action]: Take 1 direct damage to heal 3 horror, or take 1 direct horror to heal 3 damage. Flip this asset over.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
[reaction] After the round ends, if you took no damage or horror this round: Flip this asset over to its [[Unbroken]] side.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
You get +1 [intellect].
[action]: If you have fewer than 5 cards in your hand: Draw cards until there are 5 cards in your hand. Flip this asset over.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
[reaction] After the round ends, if your hand did not have 2 or more cards in it at any point this round: Flip this asset over to its [[Unbroken]] side.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
You get +1 [combat].
[action]: You get +5 skill value for the next skill test you perform this turn. After that skill test ends, flip this asset over. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
[reaction] After the round ends, if you performed no skill tests this round: Flip this asset over to its [[Unbroken]] side.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
You get +1 [agility].
[action]: One at a time, take up to 3 different fight or evade actions. Flip this asset over. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Discipline
text:
Lily Chen deck only. Permanent.
[reaction] After the round ends, if no enemies were at the same location as you at any point this round: Flip this asset over to its [[Unbroken]] side.

name: Burden of Destiny
text: Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Flip a Discipline you control to its [[Broken]] side. It cannot be flipped back this round. - Take 1 damage and 1 horror.
flavor: "How can I save them if I can't even save myself?"

name: Bob Jenkins
text:
At any time, an investigator at your location may reveal to you the [[Item]] assets in their hand.
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play an [[Item]] asset from the hand of an investigator at your location, under their control. (Both investigators may spend resources to pay its cost).
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each [[Item]] asset you control.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Shrewd Dealings, Greed, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Shrewd Dealings
text:
Bob Jenkins deck only.
Reduce the cost of each [[Item]] asset you play by 1.
[reaction] When you play an [[Item]] asset: Play it under the control of any investigator at your location.
flavor: "You say the 'end of the world.' I hear 'business opportunity.'"

name: Greed
text: Revelation - Take 1 horror. If you have... - ...10 or fewer resources, take 1 additional horror. - ...5 or fewer resources, take 1 additional horror. - ...0 resources, take 1 additional horror.
flavor: Worshipped by its own cult, one might say.

name: Geared Up
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation. Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: One at a time, play any number of [[Item]] assets from your hand, reducing the cost of each by 1. During this turn, you have 3 fewer actions to take.

name: Toe to Toe
text: Fight. This attack deals +1 damage and is automatically successful. As an additional cost to perform this attack, the chosen enemy makes an attack against you.
flavor: Sometimes, the only way out is through.

name: "Get behind me!"
text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Until the end of the phase, whenever an enemy would attack another investigator at your location, it attacks you instead, then engages you. Cancel 1 horror dealt by each attack made in this way.

name: Gang Up
text: Fight. For each different class among cards you control, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
flavor: "You mess wit' one of us, you mess wit' all of us!"

name: Sweeping Kick
text: Fight. Add your [agility] to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
flavor: "Very good, Li. Now, again."

name: Defensive Stance
text: While Defensive Stance is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains [combat] icons equal to your [agility], and [agility] icons equal to your [combat].
flavor: You slide your feet into position, take a deep breath, and center yourself. They are many, but you are one.

name: Butterfly Swords
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. That attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: In a practiced grip, they are an extension of the empty hand.

name: Dodge
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, test [agility] (1). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Combat Training
text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Combat Training before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: On the Hunt
text: Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase. Instead, search the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), attach On the Hunt to it, and shuffle the encounter deck. [reaction] When you defeat attached enemy: Gain 3 resources.

name: Fang of Tyr'thrha
text: Fight. Choose an enemy at any revealed location as the target for this attack. Before resolving this attack, you may move to that enemy's location. Add your [agility] to your [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage.
flavor: The fangs of Tindalos reach any prey.

name: Butterfly Swords
text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. If both attacks are successful, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to have the second attack deal +1 damage.

name: Forced Learning
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Increase your deck size by 15.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, draw 2 cards and discard 1 of them.

name: Jeremiah Kirby
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After Jeremiah Kirby enters play, choose "even" or "odd:" Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Draw each card with a cost that matches the chosen option. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

name: Archive of Conduits
text:
Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this asset, place 1 resource on 4 different locations, as leylines.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate a location with a leyline, exhaust this asset: Move that leyline onto this asset. Then, if there are 4 leylines on it, discard it, take its leylines as resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the gateway."

name: Written in the Stars
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a weakness, shuffle it back into your deck. Otherwise, for the remainder of your turn, while that card is in your discard pile, commit it to each eligible skill test you perform.

name: Hiking Boots
text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Hiking Boots: Move to a connecting location with at least 1 clue, or to a connecting unrevealed location.

name: Join the Caravan
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn. Reduce the cost of this card by 1 for each different class among cards you control.
Move to any revealed location.
flavor: The true journey is the one we take in our minds.

name: Survey the Area
text: While Survey the Area is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains [intellect] icons equal to your [agility], and [agility] icons equal to your [intellect].
flavor: They won't believe you if you don't capture it on film. Hell, they probably still won't believe you.

name: Medical Texts
text: [action]: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 damage from that investigator (2 damage instead if you succeed by 2 or more). If you fail, you must either exhaust Medical Texts or deal 1 damage to that investigator.

name: Unearth the Ancients
text: Investigate. Choose up to 2 [seeker] assets in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the combined cost of the chosen assets. If you succeed, put the chosen assets into play, one at a time. For each [[Relic]] asset put into play by this ability, draw 1 card.

name: Scientific Theory
text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] or +1 [combat] for this skill test.

name: Archive of Conduits
text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator, and an enemy with a leyline at a revealed location. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Archive of Conduits
text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a revealed location.
[action]: Choose an investigator and a revealed location with a leyline. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to have them take an investigate action.

name: Archive of Conduits
text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator engaged with an enemy with a leyline. That investigator disengages from that enemy and moves to a connecting location. You may remove the leyline to automatically evade that enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Archive of Conduits
text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to an investigator.
[action]: Choose an investigator with a leyline. That investigator draws 1 card and heals 1 damage or 1 horror. You may remove the leyline to have them instead draw 2 cards and heal 2 damage or 2 horror.

name: Prophesiae Profana
text:
While you are not at the locus, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [agility], and you may ignore attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After Prophesiae Profana enters play: Choose a revealed location. That location is "the locus" until Prophesiae Profana leaves play.
[action]: Move any investigator to the locus.

name: Underworld Support
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each non-weakness, non-signature card (by title).
Reduce your deck size by 5.

name: Scout Ahead
text: Move. Move up to 3 times. Enemies do not engage you during this movement.
flavor: "... a viewless aura repelled me and bade me retreat from antique and sinister secrets that no man should see, and no man else had ever dared to see." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Nameless City"

name: 21 or Bust
text:
One at a time, reveal random tokens from the chaos bag until you choose to stop. Treat each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] as a 5; the [auto_fail] as a 10; and the [elder_sign] as either a 1 or an 11. If the combined value of those tokens (ignoring +/-) is...
- ...18 or less, gain 4 resources.
- ...19, gain 5 resources.
- ...20, gain 6 resources.
- ...21, gain 9 resources.

name: Counterespionage
text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery.
Cancel that card's revelation effect and draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "the encounter deck" to "your deck".
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "you" to "any investigator".

name: Cheat the System
text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Gain 1 resource for each different class among cards you control.
flavor: If you weren't supposed to do it, it wouldn't be legal.

name: Untimely Transaction
text: Reveal an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Another investigator at your location may play that asset as if it were in their hand. If they do, draw 1 card and gain resources equal to that asset's printed cost.
flavor: "Really? You're going to haggle with me now?"

name: Savant
text: Savant gains [wild] icons equal to your lowest skill other than the skill being tested.
flavor: Fifty percent luck, a hundred percent skill.

name: The Red Clock
text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: Either place 1 charge here, or take all charges here, as resources. Then, if it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +3 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 2 times. - 3 charges, you may take an additional action this turn.

name: Money Talks
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location initiates a skill test.
Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. The performing investigator's base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down). Draw 1 card.

name: Black Market
text:
Fast. Play at the start of the investigation phase.
One at a time, reveal cards from the top of any investigator deck(s) until exactly 5 cards have been revealed. Set those cards aside, out of play. While set aside, any investigator may play any of those cards as if they were in their hand. At the start of the next investigation phase, shuffle each of those cards still set aside into its owner's deck.

name: Moxie
text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Moxie before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

name: The Black Fan
text:
Exceptional.
While you have...
- ...10+ resources, you get +1 health and +1 sanity.
- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.
- ...20+ resources, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: The Red Clock
text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: You may take all charges here, as resources. Place 1 charge here. If it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +4 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 3 times. - 3 charges, you may take 2 additional actions this turn.

name: Down the Rabbit Hole
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first 2 cards you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.
Increase the experience cost for you to purchase new cards by 1.

name: Dragon Pole
text: You have 1 additional arcane slot. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack for each of your arcane slots that is filled. If at least 2 of your arcane slots are filled, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: Meditative Trance
text: For each of your arcane slots that is filled, either heal 1 damage or 1 horror.
flavor: You let your mind drift into cold, meaningless oblivion. The emptiness feels like home.

name: Close the Circle
text:
Uses (1 charge for each class among cards you control, including this one).
[fast] Spend 1 charge and exhaust Close the Circle: Take a basic action. For each skill test performed during that action, you may use your [willpower] instead of the skill indicated for that action.

name: Winds of Power
text:
Place 2 charges on an asset you control.
[reaction] After you draw Winds of Power during your turn: Play it.
flavor: May Oya's breath guide us all.

name: Foresight
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location would draw a card from their deck or from the encounter deck.
Name a card. If the drawn card is the named card, that investigator may either (choose one):
- Cancel that card's effects and discard it.
- Immediately play that card at -2 cost.

name: Occult Theory
text: While Occult Theory is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains [willpower] icons equal to your [intellect], and [intellect] icons equal to your [willpower].
flavor: When knowledge is lacking, belief must suffice.

name: Parallel Fates
text: Look at the top 6 cards of an investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may either return them to the top of that deck in any order, or shuffle them into that deck. If you looked at an investigator's deck, that investigator may draw 1 card.
flavor: "If I said that I could tell you when you were going to die, would you want to know?"

name: Astronomical Atlas
text:
[fast] Exhaust Astronomical Atlas: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, attach it facedown to Astronomical Atlas (max 5 cards attached).
[fast]: Commit a card attached to Astronomical Atlas to an eligible skill test. If that test succeeds, add that card to your hand instead of discarding it. (Limit once per test.)

name: Healing Words
text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 2 damage from among investigators at your location.
flavor: You don't necessarily trust the occult words, but you have no other choice.

name: Grounded
text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 skill value during skill tests on [[Spell]] cards.
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Grounded before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, spend 1 resource: You get +1 skill value for this test.

name: True Magick
text: Uses (1 charge). Replenish this charge at the start of each round. You may resolve abilities on [[Spell]] assets in your hand by revealing them from your hand. Treat True Magick as if it were the revealed asset (to pay its costs, spend charges, perfom its effect, etc).

name: Short Supply
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation. Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.
flavor: You can only pray that it's enough.

name: Schoffner's Catalogue
text:
Uses (5 secrets). If Schoffner's Catalogue has no secrets, discard it.
You may spend secrets on Schoffner's Catalogue as resources to pay for [[Item]] assets played by any investigator at your location.

name: Bandages
text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Bandages has no supplies, discard it.
[reaction] After an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location takes 1 or more damage, spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage from that card.

name: Jury-Rig
text:
Uses (3 durability).
Attach to an [[Item]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
[fast] During a skill test on attached asset, spend 1 durability: You get +2 skill value for this test.
flavor: If it ain't broke, make it better.

name: Bangle of Jinxes
text:
Uses (1 charge).
[fast] Spend 1 charge: You get +2 skill value for this test. (Limit once per test.)
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you: Place 1 charge on Bangle of Jinxes.

name: Burn After Reading
text: Exile a level 0-5 card in your hand. Discover 2 clues at your location. If the exiled card was level 2 or higher, remove 1 doom from the current agenda. Exile Burn After Reading. Card designed by the Council-in-Exile at Gen Con 2020

name: Strength in Numbers
text: Strength in Numbers gains a [wild] icon for each different class among cards you control.
flavor: "Watch my back, will ya? In fact, watch my front, too."

name: Dauntless Spirit
text: While Dauntless Spirit is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains [willpower] icons equal to your [combat], and [combat] icons equal to your [willpower].
flavor: This day just keeps getting better and better.

name: Blood Will Have Blood
text:
Fast. Play after an enemy attacks you. Max 1 per attack.
Damage/horror from this attack cannot be assigned to [[Ally]] assets. For each point of damage and/or horror you took from this attack, draw 1 card.

name: Fire Extinguisher
text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Discard Fire Extinguisher: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies engaged with you. You may exile Fire Extinguisher instead of discarding it to discard each non-[[Elite]] enemy evaded by this effect.

name: Plucky
text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Plucky before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [intellect] for this skill test.

name: Fend Off
text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location.
That enemy attacks you. Then, automatically evade that enemy and attach Fend Off to it.
Attached enemy cannot ready.

name: Medical Student
text: [reaction] After Medical Student enters play: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: "Can I get course credit for this?"

name: On the Trail
text: Choose an enemy at any location other than yours. Either move twice toward that enemy, or discover 1 clue at any empty location between you and the chosen enemy, along the shortest path to reach that enemy.
flavor: "The game is afoot!"

name: On the Trail
text: Choose an enemy at any location other than yours. Move twice toward that enemy. Discover 1 clue at each location you entered by this effect.
flavor: "The game is afoot!"

name: Michael Leigh
text: You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat]. [reaction] After you successfully investigate: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Michael Leigh, as evidence (to a maximum of 3 evidence). [reaction] When you initiate an attack, exhaust Michael Leigh and spend 1 evidence: You deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Snipe
text: During the next fight action you perform this turn using a [[Ranged]] or [[Firearm]] asset, treat each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token you reveal as a "0" token. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Old Shotgun
text: Uses (0 ammo). While playing an event, treat Old Shotgun's uses value as 2. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack's damage is equal to the amount you succeed by, or fail by if you fail and would damage another investigator (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 3).

name: Quickdraw Holster
text:
[fast]: Choose a [[Firearm]] asset taking up only 1 hand slot in your play area. Attach it to Quickdraw Holster, or switch it with the attached asset. The attached asset takes up no hand slots. (Limit 1 attached asset.)
[fast] Exhaust Quickdraw Holster: Perform a fight action on the attached asset without paying its [action] cost.

name: Brand of Cthugha
text: Uses (6 charges). [action]: Fight. For this attack, you may use [willpower] instead of [combat], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 or 2 charges. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each charge spent. If you succeed by 0, lose 1 action.

name: Nkosi Mabati
text: [reaction] After Nkosi Mabati enters play: Name a non-[elder_sign] chaos token with a symbol. Until this card leaves play, the named symbol is your "sigil." [reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol, exhaust Nkosi Mabati: Search the chaos bag for your sigil and reveal it, instead (returning the other token to the chaos bag).

name: Brand of Cthugha
text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Fight. For this attack, you may use [willpower] instead of [combat], and you get +2 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1, 2, or 3 charges. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each charge spent. If you succeed by 0, lose 2 actions.

name: Cyclopean Hammer
text: [action]: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. You deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move it one location away from you. (If you succeed by 3 or more, you instead deal +2 damage and may move the enemy up to two locations away from you.)

name: Sledgehammer

name: Skittering Nonsense
text: Hunter. Forced - When you defeat Skittering Nonsense: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Skittering Nonsense attacks you).

name: Apeirophobia
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shelter value. If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Take 1 horror for each point you failed by. - Place 2 of your clues on your location. - Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.

name: Zero Visibility
text: Revelation - Put Zero Visibility into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to leave a location with a treachery attached to it, you must spend 1 action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Zero Visibility.

name: Cold Welcome
text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
backText: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
flavor: This isn't exactly how you imagined your first foray into the Antarctic wilds. The stinging cold and lashing, frozen winds will only get worse over time.

name: Into the White
text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
backText: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
flavor: Something dwells beneath the ice. Something you've never seen or heard of before, not even in William Dyer's horrifying report. Something...unreal.

name: Running Out of Time
text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
backText: Each investigator, including those who are eliminated, shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck. Choose a location in play with no clues on it. Each undefeated investigator moves to that location and immediately resigns. The higher that location's shelter value, the better. If the investigators cannot choose such a location, they must move to the Crash Site and immediately resign, even if they otherwise could not. (Then, resolve the [[Objective]] on act 1a.)
flavor: The sun hangs low in the sky, but never sets. Your party is exhausted from the long, arduous day. Though the sky is never plunged into the dark of night, you know it's only a matter of time before you are forced to make camp.

name: Search for a Camp Site
text: [action] If each investigator is at the same location and that location has no clues on it: Resign. You set up camp. Each investigator resigns. Objective - Find somewhere safe to set up camp. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. The higher the shelter value of the location they resigned at, the better.
flavor: You're going to have to find a way back to camp, and soon...or you'll have to make due camping in the wilds.

name: Terror of the Stars
text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators cannot resign at its location or discover clues at its location.

name: A Harsh Wind Blows
backText: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
flavor: Several of your party have mysteriously vanished in the night. Without a sign of any struggle, you can only assume they left of their own accord...but why?

name: The Chill of Night
backText: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
flavor: The low-hanging sun dimly illuminates the Antarctic night. Gray clouds cover the sky, threatening an icy storm.

name: Madness and Death
backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R1)
flavor: The storm grows closer, and with it looming in the sky, that damnable sound returns. It haunts you with its presence, worming its way into your mind. Is it the cause of this folly? This madness?

name: The Lost Expedition
text: [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the encounter card beneath your location. [action] If you are at camp: Resign. You turn in for the night. Objective - Find as many missing expedition members as you can by adding them to the victory display, then head back to camp before daybreak. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You set out to search for the missing team members, hoping to find them before daybreak...

name: Dead End
text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: There is nothing here but ice and snow, and no sign of any missing team members. Frustrated, you turn back. You won't find anyone here.

name: Cracks in the Ice
text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor:
As you traverse the glacial wilds, something rumbles and churns beneath your feet. Is that where these creatures are coming from? In the depths of the ice?
A somber thought crosses your mind. If you are right, such entities could exert their vile influence no matter where you stand. Perhaps this has something to do with your missing companions after all, though there are no signs of them here.

name: Somber Remains
text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: You come across evidence of one of your lost companions, abandoned and half-buried in snow - torn scraps from a heavy fur coat and a pair of goggles. Examining the goggles closely yields a terrifying discovery - a dark, sticky substance that you cannot, for the life of you, identify.

name: Disappearing Footprints
text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor:
The tracks continue for some time before vanishing, bafflingly, into the snow. There's no sign of any struggle, nor are there any other tracks that might indicate where they could have gone. Could the winds have covered the tracks? And if so, why were you able to follow the rest of the footprints so easily?
But when you turn back to examine the prints you first followed, they too are gone.

name: Dissected Explorer
text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: You follow a set of tracks into a small cavern carved into a glacial wall, and your stomach lurches at the sight before you. One of your missing team members lies in a crumpled heap at the end of the hollow, his clothing torn open. A clean vertical incision has bisected his torso open from his sternum to his belly, and his entrails have been carefully removed. You struggle not to retch. Who could have possibly done such a thing?

name: Evil Within
text:
Discard an [[Eidolon]] enemy that does not have the [[Elite]] trait from play.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: You are fleeing from a creature made of kaleidoscopic ooze when you suddenly freeze in place, a web of cracks reaching out across the ice beneath your boots. Your breath catches in your throat. Another step could spell your doom or save your life. Behind you, the entity gains on you, reaching out with arms that are not quite solid or liquid. Feeling lucky, you decide to roll the dice, striking the ground behind you and fleeing to the side. Just as you hoped, the ice is thin enough to splinter open, and the creature tumbles down through the crack, into the icy depths. You breathe a sigh of relief, thankful you did not share a similar fate.

name: Bloody Evidence
text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: You follow a set of footprints through the snow, hoping they will lead you to a sign, any sign, of your lost companions. Sadly, the evidence you discover is not the kind you were hoping to find. Where the prints end, you find an ice pick covered in freshly frozen blood. To your horror, a human eye lies nearby, staining the snow red. A shudder creeps up your spine. What on Earth could compel somebody to do such a thing?

name: Madness Inside
text:
Choose a [[Possessed]] enemy in play that does not have the [[Elite]] trait. Take control of each doom on that enemy, flipping them to their clue sides. Discard the chosen enemy.
Add this story card to the victory display.
flavor: To your relief, you come across one of your missing team members - but they are not themself. Their eyes glazed over, their expression dazed and lost. A murky, slimy substance drips from their face and trickles onto the ice below. When you finally manage to get through to them, they wipe the strange, inky miasma from their face, staining their cheeks black. "What...was I doing?" they ask.

name: Professor William Dyer
text: [action] Choose and discard up to 2 cards from your hand: Parley. Place that many resources on Professor William Dyer (from the token bank). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Professor William Dyer is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

name: Danforth
text: [action]: Parley. You listen closely to Danforth's rambling. Draw up to 2 cards from the top of the Tekeli-li deck. Then, place that many resources on Danforth (from the token pool). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Danforth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Eliyah Ashevak is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Avery Claypool is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (2) to wrestle the gun away from Cookie. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If James "Cookie" Fredericks is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] or [agility] (5) to get Ellsworth to let go of the strange rock he is clutching. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Roald Ellsworth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.

text: [action] Spend up to 3 resources: Parley. Place each of these resources on Takada Hiroko. If there are 5 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Takada Hiroko is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.

name: Manifestations of Evil
text: Forced - When this agenda would advance, if there is at least 1 facedown card beneath a Seeping Nightmare: Instead of advancing this agenda, remove 2 doom from play and find the Seeping Nightmare with the most facedown cards beneath it. Choose one of the cards beneath it at random and spawn it at its location.
backText:
The lead investigator must decide (choose one):
- Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
- In player order, each investigator shuffles the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck (each investigator who cannot takes 1 damage and 1 horror instead).
flavor: Something stirs beneath the ice. Through the cracks, a vile ichor bubbles forth, its odor pungent and rancid.

name: Icy Depths
backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The violent quakes have risen to a crescendo. Any second now, you feel as though the entire ice shelf could collapse, spilling you into the frigid ocean - or worse, if your theory about the underground source of these creatures is correct.

name: Under Attack!
text: Each [[Eidolon]] enemy gains Victory 0. The camp gains: "[action] Investigators at your location spend 4 clues, as a group: Resign." Objective - If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play, advance. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
backText:
If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play:
The last of the nightmarish creatures falls, its miasmatic body at once dissolving into inky, prismatic liquid and dissipating into wisps of gray mist filled with screaming shapes. Then, silence.
(→R1)
If the investigators advanced by resigning:
You follow a makeshift path through a jagged split in the ice shelf, making your way deeper into the mainland, toward the mountains. You don't know if these creatures can follow human tracks - or indeed if they need tracks at all in order to pursue you - but you take the time to cover them, regardless. Hopefully, with this shortcut you've found, you'll be safe...
(→R2)
flavor: Your camp has been discovered, and now the monsters prowling about the ice and snow are converging on your position. You have only two ways out of this nightmare: you must fight, or you must flee.

name: Seeping Nightmare
text: While an [[Eidolon]] enemy at Seeping Nightmare's location is moving, its location is considered connected to the camp. While there are no facedown cards beneath Seeping Nightmare, it gains hunter. Forced - When Seeping Nightmare is defeated: Remove each facedown card beneath it from the game.

name: Phantasmagoria
text: Revelation - If there are no Seeping Nightmares in play, Phantasmagoria gains surge. Otherwise, find the Seeping Nightmare nearest to an investigator. If there are 1 or more cards beneath it, choose one of them at random and spawn it at its location. If there are no cards beneath it, it moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting).

name: Fatal Mirage
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of story cards in the victory display.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, you must either move to the Prison of Memories, or shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 doom on an [[Eidolon]] enemy in play.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number plus the number of story cards in the victory display.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, you must either move to the Prison of Memories, or shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it. (If you fail by 2 or more, do both instead.)
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, place 1 doom on an [[Eidolon]] enemy in play.

name: Ethereal Tangle (v. I)
text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
flavor: You find yourself trapped in an endless prison of distorted thought. Each door is another world to discover, another memory to explore...

name: Ethereal Tangle (v. II)
text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
flavor: You once again find yourself trapped in an endless prison of distorted thought...

name: Ethereal Tangle (v. III)
text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
backText: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
flavor: You once again find yourself trapped in an endless prison of distorted thought...

name: Shadow of the Past (v. I)
text: Objective - Confront your demons to strengthen your resolve. (Hint: You may have more than one opportunity to advance this act. Until then, you are trapped. If you are running out of time and are given the chance to advance, consider taking it...)
flavor: In this strange, alternate reality, past memories and nightmares come to life. Is this place real or a figment of your imagination? Or perhaps both?

name: Shadow of the Past (v. II)
text: Objective - Confront your demons to strengthen your resolve. (Hint: You may have more than one opportunity to advance this act. Until then, you are trapped. If you are running out of time and are given the chance to advance, consider taking it...)
flavor: In this strange, alternate reality, past memories and nightmares come to life. Is this place real or a figment of your imagination? Or perhaps both?

name: Shadow of the Past (v. III)
text: Objective - Confront your demons to strengthen your resolve. (Hint: You may have more than one opportunity to advance this act. Until then, you are trapped. If you are running out of time and are given the chance to advance, consider taking it...)
flavor: In this strange, alternate reality, past memories and nightmares come to life. Is this place real or a figment of your imagination? Or perhaps both?

name: Prison of Memories
text:
Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Base Camp, Deck of the Theodosia, University Halls).
X is the current agenda number.

name: Prison of Memories
text:
Choose one:
- Put the set-aside Base Camp location into play.
- Put the set-aside Deck of the Theodosia location into play.
- Put the set-aside University Halls location into play.
Flip this card back over.
flavor:
You wander for what seems like hours through the myriad reflections. The further you venture from where you arrived, the more distant reality becomes. There are many paths to take through the hallucination. Places you recognize from your memories, and others you do not, taken from the memories of your companions.
As the shape of the mirage changes around you, you consider which prison might be worse - the one that reveals its true, deadly nature? Or the one that hides it?

name: Base Camp
text:
Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Coastal Waters, Deserted Station, Riverview Theatre).
[reaction] When you would you fail a skill test by exactly 1 while investigating Base Camp, take 1 horror: You get +1 skill value for this test.

name: Base Camp
text: Choose one: - Follow Takada's memories. Put the set-aside Coastal Waters location into play. - Follow Eliyah's memories. Put the set-aside Deserted Station location into play. - Follow Dr. Sinha's memories. Put the set-aside Riverview Theatre location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
Eliyah and his companion, Anyu, shimmer into view along the outskirts of the camp. "Where have you been?" Takada says, also appearing before your very eyes.
"It is foolish to venture out alone," Dr. Sinha joins in the scolding.
"Relax. I wasn't alone," Eliyah replies, his gloved hand gently petting Anyu's neck.
The physician rolls her eyes and departs, but Takada remains, folding her arms across her chest. "There is still a lot to do before we head out, you know," she states.
Eliyah sighs and nods. "I know. Just...anxious. Something about this place..." he trails off.
Takada nods. "Yes. I feel it, too."

name: Deck of the Theodosia
text: Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Coastal Waters, Hedge Maze, Standing Stones). Forced - When you investigate Deck of the Theodosia: You must either give it +2 shroud for this investigation, or spend 1 additional action to investigate it.

name: Deck of the Theodosia
text: Choose one: - Follow Cookie's memories. Put the set-aside Coastal Waters location into play. - Follow Ellsworth's memories. Put the set-aside Hedge Maze location into play. - Follow Claypool's memories. Put the set-aside Standing Stones location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
Ellsworth appears in a shimmer of mirage-light, staring out over the railing into the cold, blue ocean. "Beautiful, isn't it?" he says.
Cookie and Claypool appear nearby, carrying several crates of supplies between them. "Y'know what would be beautiful?" Cookie hollers. "If maybe yeh helped out a lil' bit. Think yeh might get off yer ass for a minute 'n pitch in, Ellsworth?"
The explorer nods with a soft sigh and takes the weight from Claypool's hands, nodding aside for him to take a break. Claypool gives him a gentle, knowing smile.

name: University Halls
text: Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Elder Chamber, Riverview Theatre, Standing Stones). Forced - When University Halls is flipped over: Each investigator discards the top 3 cards of their deck for each clue they spent. Each investigator draws each Tekeli-li weakness they discarded in this way. Shuffle each other weakness discarded in this way back into its owner's deck.

name: University Halls
text: Choose one: - Follow Danforth's memories. Put the set-aside Elder Chamber location into play. - Follow Dr. Kensler's memories. Put the set-aside Riverview Theatre location into play. - Follow Dyer's memories. Put the set-aside Standing Stones location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
Three figures shimmer into view as they cross one another in the darkened halls. "Professor," you hear Dr. Kensler's voice acknowledge, and her outline becomes defined. Professor Dyer and his protégé appear next. "I do hope you'll consider my proposal," she continues. If she truly cared one way or the other, her tone of voice surely does not reveal it.
In response, Dyer simply glances at Danforth, who appears to be staring behind her - far, far behind her. "Well. In any event..." she adjusts her glasses, and enters the door labeled with her name.
Dyer shakes his head with a sigh, but Danforth is the one who breaks the silence. "I...I think we should go."

name: Hedge Maze
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Mo'ai Statues). Forced - After you investigate Hedge Maze during your turn: Increase its shroud value by 1 until the end of your turn. You cannot leave Hedge Maze this turn.

name: Hedge Maze
text:
Put the set-aside Mo'ai Statues location into play.
Flip this card back over.
flavor: "You really think I can't navigate a simple maze?" Ellsworth chuckles. He looks several years younger and wears a proper tuxedo instead of his comfortable jacket and trousers. The figure he speaks to stands just out of view, a dark silhouette with a muffled, indistinct voice. "Fine," the explorer replies with a roll of his eyes. He hands the figure his champagne glass and loosens his tie. "But when I get back, you are going to tell me what this is really all about."

name: Deserted Station
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Alaskan Wilds).
Deserted Station gets +3 shroud while there is at least one treachery attached to it.

name: Deserted Station
text:
Put the set-aside Alaskan Wilds location into play.
Flip this card back over.
flavor:
When Eliyah materializes into view, you are stunned to see him without his steadfast companion, Anyu. He holds an unfamiliar woman's hands, her wavy hair the color of a brilliant ruby. The two young lovers stare into one another's eyes as the old train approaches. "How long do you think you will be gone?"
"I...I'm not sure," he confesses. "It is a lengthy journey. Alaska is a hell of a big place."
"So, this is goodbye, then," the woman says. She wipes angry tears from her eyes. "Will you write?"
"I'll try, but..." he glances away.
"Right, right," she says, understanding. The train pulls into the station, its piercing squeal muffling their words. "You...fool." She leans up and kisses his cheek. "You are a fool, Eliyah."
"I...I know," he replies. "I know."

name: Coastal Waters
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Airfield, Ottoman Front). Forced - After you reveal a [frost] token while investigating Coastal Waters: Take 1 horror. If this investigation is successful, discover 1 additional clue at Coastal Waters. (Limit once per test.)

name: Coastal Waters
text: Choose one: - Follow Takada's memories. Put the set-aside Airfield location into play. - Follow Cookie's memories. Put the set-aside Ottoman Front location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
"Hell of a test run!" Cookie yells over the roar of the rushing wind. The two of them are up in one of Takada's aeroplanes - this must have happened just after she completed work on the first plane, before the lot of you set off toward the peaks, and the events that ensued.
"Get used to it!" Takada shouts from the pilot's seat. "Weather's gonna be rough anytime we're in the air. Don't worry though, she'll hold." You see the grim copilot hold back a smile. "You're enjoying this, aren't you?" Takada chimes.
"Naw," Cookie lies. "Just been a while, is all."

name: Elder Chamber
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Cluttered Dormitory). Forced - After you discover 2 or more clues from Elder Chamber during a single investigation or card effect: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck.

name: Elder Chamber
text:
Put the set-aside Cluttered Dormitory location into play.
Flip this card back over.
flavor:
These are the sledges missing from Lake's camp," Professor Dyer remarks, shimmering into view. He doesn't sound particularly surprised - it seems they must have accounted for this possibility.
Danforth is already at the first of the sledges, examining its contents. "Here's the gasoline stove, the fuel, all of their research instruments..." he trails off. "God, what is that awful stench?" He motions toward the farthest sledge, the tarpaulin strapped around its cargo bulging oddly.
"Danforth, don't-" Dyer calls out, but it's too late. The moment Danforth removes the tarpaulin, he staggers backward, covering his mouth and nose. Frozen and preserved beneath the tarpaulin are the corpses of a young explorer and one of his sled dogs.
"Gedney," Dyer whispers.

name: Riverview Theatre
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Dr. Kensler's Office, Infirmary). Forced - When you draw a Tekeli-li card while at Riverview Theatre: Resolve its effects an additional time. Then, discover 1 clue at Riverview Theatre.

name: Riverview Theatre
text: Choose one: - Follow Dr. Kensler's memories. Put the set-aside Dr. Kensler's Office location into play. - Follow Dr. Sinha's memories. Put the set-aside Infirmary location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
"Thank you for...for inviting me here, Dr. Sinha," Dr. Kensler says quietly, her outline shimmering into view. She and Dr. Sinha sit next to one another in the almost-empty theatre. The lights are dim and the curtain drawn, but the show has not yet begun.
"Of course. And just Mala is fine."
Kensler flinches and clears her throat. "Then call me Amy."
"I already do," the physician replies as the screen in front of them kindles to life.

name: Standing Stones
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (The Black Stone, Dyer's Classroom). Forced - After you reveal a [frost] token while investigating Standing Stones: Take 1 damage. If this investigation is successful, discover 1 additional clue at Standing Stones. (Limit once per test.)

name: Standing Stones
text: Choose one: - Follow Claypool's memories. Put the set-aside The Black Stone location into play. - Follow Dyer's memories. Put the set-aside Dyer's Classroom location into play. Flip this card back over.
flavor:
Claypool stares up at the ruins with a twinkle of wonder in his eyes. "Marvelous, isn't it, William?" Behind him, Professor Dyer materializes within the mirage. Both of them are at least a decade younger, perhaps more. You note Claypool did not address the professor by his title.
"Marvelous and mysterious," Dyer replies. "Nobody knows the true purpose of this site. Perhaps nobody ever will."
"But that's why we do this, right?" Claypool says with a grin. "To learn the truth."
Dyer glances back at the youth, lines of worry pulling at his eyes. "Yes," he whispers, "the truth."

name: Airfield
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Missing Father).
While Takada Hiroko is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
As an additional cost for you to investigate Airfield, you must spend 1 resource.

name: Airfield
text: If Takada Hiroko is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Missing Father enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Takada Hiroko is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: A teenage girl shimmers into view. You recognize Takada's chestnut eyes and thin, straight hair. Her cheeks are stained with tears and rain. She waves as the old, rickety aeroplane takes off. You don't recognize the design - this must have been over a decade ago. "Don't worry, kiddo." The man next to her grips her shoulder encouragingly. "He'll be back soon," he reassures her, his voice soft with compassion. "You'll see."

name: Alaskan Wilds
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry).
While Eliyah Ashevak is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
As an additional cost for you to enter Alaskan Wilds, you must either shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck, or spend 1 action.

name: Alaskan Wilds
text: If Eliyah Ashevak is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Eliyah Ashevak is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: Eliyah sits huddled up against a tree, a torrent of snow falling around him. In his arms, Anyu whines. Blood soaks his gloves, staining the dog's fur red as he holds her tight. "I know, girl," he chants, "I know, I know. We...we are going to be okay. You and me, girl. Anyu, right? That was your name?" The dog peers up into his eyes. "We will be okay, Anyu. I promise you."

name: Cluttered Dormitory
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Unspeakable Evil). While Danforth is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - When you resolve the revelation ability on a Tekeli-li card while at Cluttered Dormitory: Shuffle it back into your deck instead of placing it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.

name: Cluttered Dormitory
text: If Danforth is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of an Unspeakable Evil enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Danforth is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: Danforth screams and throws his covers aside. Sweat drenches his forehead and drips down his cheeks. "Just a dream," he whispers. "Just a dream, just a dream." He collapses from his bed, dabs his head with a handkerchief, and wanders over to the nearby window to peer outside. The shape he sees on the other side causes him to leap back in fear, crashing into the opposite wall. "No...no!"

name: Dyer's Classroom
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Regretful Voyage).
While Professor William Dyer is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
[action] Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.

name: Dyer's Classroom
text: If Professor William Dyer is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Regretful Voyage enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Professor William Dyer is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor:
Dyer shakes the man's hand vigorously, a smile beaming across his face. "You have no idea how much this means to me," he exclaims. "This will be a journey of profound importance. For all of us."
You recognize the man he speaks to - it is the late Professor Lake, one of many who ventured with Dyer to Antarctica and never returned.
"Yes, William," Lake replies, his eyes dribbling over with terrible black ichor. "This expedition will change everything."

name: Infirmary
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Lost Patient). While Dr. Mala Sinha is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you enter Infirmary for the first time this game, if you have more than 6 remaining health: Take damage until you have exactly 6 remaining health. Otherwise, take 1 damage.

name: Infirmary
text: If Dr. Mala Sinha is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Lost Patient enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Dr. Mala Sinha is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: A young Dr. Sinha appears by the bedside, her face contorted with grief. You have never seen her so stricken. A nurse places a hand on top of Dr. Sinha's in consolation, but she bats it away. "Don't," she barks, choking back a sob. "There is nothing more you could have done, Doctor," the nurse says. "There is always more that can be done," Dr. Sinha shouts. "We could have been smarter! Faster!" Her hands shake as she tries to make a fist. Black miasma seeps from between her knuckles. "We - I - this is my fault. All my fault."

name: Dr. Kensler's Office
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Unrequited Love). While Dr. Amy Kensler is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you successfully investigate Dr. Kensler's Office: You must either take 1 horror, or remove 1 secret from an asset you control.

name: Dr. Kensler's Office
text: If Dr. Amy Kensler is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of an Unrequited Love enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Dr. Amy Kensler is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: Dr. Kensler sits at her desk, struggling to focus on her work. Various papers sit in neat piles around her, and the bookshelf is perfectly ordered, just as you would expect from the professor. But the journal she writes in is cluttered and unkempt. She runs her hand through her hair, undoing her ponytail. "No, no, no..." she mutters, ripping a piece of paper from the book. You spot a photograph serving as a bookmark, keeping her page as she shuts the journal angrily. She opens one of her desk drawers and throws the crumpled paper inside, barely noticing the way the drawer bubbles over with miasma, and the putrid gray mist emanating from within...

name: Mo'ai Statues
text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Alien Translation). While Roald Ellsworth is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - When the revelation effect of a treachery attaches it to Mo'ai Statues: That treachery gains surge. (Limit once per phase.)

name: Mo'ai Statues
text: If Roald Ellsworth is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of an Alien Translation enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Roald Ellsworth is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: Rain patters against the face of the statue as Ellsworth examines the inscription at its foundation. "This one isn't like the rest," he murmurs to himself. "This isn't Rapa Nui. This isn't one of the mo'ai at all." The statue in the mirage cracks open, and miasma begins to seep from inside...

name: Ottoman Front
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Ravaged Country).
While James "Cookie" Fredericks is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at Ottoman Front gets +2 fight and loses retaliate.

name: Ottoman Front
text: If James "Cookie" Fredericks is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Ravaged Country enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If James "Cookie" Fredericks is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor:
Through the din of war - a hail of gunfire and mortars so loud it shakes the earth - Cookie reloads his rifle, slowly and methodically. "Sergeant Fredericks!" a voice calls out to him. His companion ducks through the trench as another nearby explosion kicks up a spray of mud. "Germans broke the line last night. They're circling around. We have to get out of here!"
Cookie affixes a bayonet to the end of his rifle. "Did the lieutenant give the order?" he asks.
"Lieutenant Williams is dead," the soldier replies, the fear in his voice palpable. "Sir...you're in charge."

name: The Black Stone
text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Terrible Discovery).
While Avery Claypool is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
[fast] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Discover 2 clues at The Black Stone. (Group limit once per game.)

name: The Black Stone
text: If Avery Claypool is alive: Spawn the set-aside Memory of a Terrible Discovery enemy at this location. Flip this card back over. If Avery Claypool is crossed out: Move each investigator and enemy at this location to Prison of Memories. Discard each card attached to this location. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor:
"According to Inuit legend, this megalith has stood here since before humanity walked the Earth," a young Avery recounts, examining the runic language along its surface.
"I don't know about any of that, but it is definitely ancient. That's not even the weirdest part, though."
"What is?" one of the other explorers asks, pulling his hood down to get a better view of the towering structure.
"See for yourself," Claypool says, unfolding a map and placing it against the smooth stone. Drawn over the map's surface are many rings and lines depicting various weather patterns. "This thing...is like a lightning rod."

name: Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry
text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Eliyah Ashevak. [reaction] After you successfully evade this enemy by 3 or more: Deal it 3 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry
text: In your Campaign Log, record Eliyah has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Eliyah Ashevak is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "We almost died that day. Anyu and I," the real Eliyah says as the mirage fades. Anyu licks his gloved hand and whines. "We were the only two that survived. And nobody ever believed me when I told them about the creature that attacked us. They turned me into a pariah. I thought...maybe I was crazy, after all." He shudders as he recalls the shape the mirage took. "But now I know. What attacked us that day was real."

name: Memory of a Lost Patient
text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Dr. Mala Sinha. [reaction] After you heal 1 or more damage while this enemy is exhausted: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Lost Patient
text: In your Campaign Log, record Dr. Sinha has confronted her demons. Draw a checkmark next to her name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Dr. Mala Sinha is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If she is currently in play, switch her with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "I will never forget that day. The day I lost my first patient." She crosses her arms as the mirage fades. Her eyes are tired and worn. "They tell you it happens to even the best of us, but even so, we are never prepared. I was not foolish enough to vow that I would never lose another one. I knew that was a fantasy." She glances at you knowingly. "Instead, I simply vowed never to get attached. So do not be upset at my distance. It is for my own sake. So if - when - I lose you, I am not lost, myself."

name: Memory of a Missing Father
text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Takada Hiroko. [reaction] After you gain 1 or more resources while this enemy is exhausted: Deal 1 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Missing Father
text: In your Campaign Log, record Takada has confronted her demons. Draw a checkmark next to her name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Takada Hiroko is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If she is currently in play, switch her with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "He never did come home," Takada whispers, choking on her words. "I spent my whole life following in his footsteps. I thought...I thought if I did, maybe..." she wipes the tears - and inky miasma - from her eyes. "He's gone. Gone forever."

name: Memory of a Ravaged Country
text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with James "Cookie" Fredericks. [reaction] After this enemy attacks you: Deal it 1 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Ravaged Country
text: In your Campaign Log, record Cookie has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever James "Cookie" Fredericks is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: As the mirage dissolves, you watch a young Sergeant James Fredericks command his men to flee, a hail of bullets and mortar fire following in their wake. "Kid never did make it back," the real Cookie says, grinding his teeth. "Very few of us did that day. And for what?" He spits. The roar of gunfire fades into the distance. "For what?"

name: Memory of a Regretful Voyage
text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Dr. William Dyer. [reaction] After you draw 1 or more cards while this enemy is exhausted: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Regretful Voyage
text: In your Campaign Log, record Dyer has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Professor William Dyer is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "We never should have gone," the real Dyer whispers as the shape of Professor Lake fades into the mirage. "I should have convinced him. I should have...but I was too greedy, too eager." he chokes. "And now, here I am again. You and I, we have led these people to their ends. Even if we survive, we will never forget what we have done to these people. What we have risked."

name: Memory of an Unspeakable Evil
text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Danforth. [action][action] Shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck: Parley. Deal 3 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of an Unspeakable Evil
text: In your Campaign Log, record Danforth has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Danforth is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "It's here, it's here," the real Danforth mutters as he sees the miasma dripping from the cracked window. "It was always here, always here and I returned, returned to hear that accursed sound..." He continues to watch in horror as the miasma retreats, returning his dormitory to its natural state. It takes several minutes for him to stop shaking.

name: Memory of a Terrible Discovery
text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Avery Claypool. [action] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Parley. Deal 4 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of a Terrible Discovery
text: In your Campaign Log, record Claypool has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Avery Claypool is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor:
"After that, there was no going back," the real Claypool explains. "We had opened Pandora's box, so to speak. I could no longer bury my head in the sand. There are forces out there beyond our comprehension. Things that science cannot explain. Just as I could not explain that stone's meteorological impact on the region. Nor could I explain the nature of the storm that hit us after we uncovered it."
You ask Claypool what happened to the other man who was with him that day. He grinds his teeth and shakes his head.

name: Memory of an Alien Translation
text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Roald Ellsworth. [reaction] After this enemy is exhausted, if there is an attachment on its location: Deal 4 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of an Alien Translation
text: In your Campaign Log, record Ellsworth has confronted his demons. Draw a checkmark next to his name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Roald Ellsworth is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If he is currently in play, switch him with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: "I...I remember this," the real Ellsworth says, staring at his own memory. "This is what made me want to become an explorer. To discover things like this. Ancient secrets, left behind by God knows what. But the more I discover, the more I think that perhaps there are parts of the Earth better left alone. Perhaps all of this is the fault of people like me, who refuse to let history lie. Arrogant fools, the lot of us."

name: Memory of an Unrequited Love
text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Dr. Amy Kensler. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this enemy's location: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Memory of an Unrequited Love
text: In your Campaign Log, record Dr. Kensler has confronted her demons. Draw a checkmark next to her name in the Expedition Team section. From now on, whenever Dr. Amy Kensler is included or used during a scenario, use the set-aside [[Resolute]] version instead of the version from the Expedition Team encounter set. If she is currently in play, switch her with that version now. Add this card to the victory display. The investigators may advance the current act or continue playing.
flavor: Dr. Kensler - the real one - eyes you coldly. "This memory is not for you," she warns. "Though I suppose you have no more control over this than I do." You cannot help but be a little curious what kind of academic work would rattle somebody like her, so you ask. "It was not academic in nature," she confesses, running her hand idly along the vision of her office desk, before pulling the photograph out from inside the journal and examining it in private. "I was never very skilled in expressing myself in...matters of the heart," she says, and the photograph fades in her hands, along with the rest of the mirage. "Come along. I do not wish to remain here any longer," she states.
